messages.被弾で敵に復讐対象を付け、攻撃・反撃で回収して仕返し帳簿を溜める中指の打撃人格。: A Middle Blunt Identity that marks enemies for vengeance when hit, then collects those marks through attacks and counters to build The Book of Vengeance. His main payoff is reaching a total Envy Absolute Resonance count of at least 6, turning defense into an S3 Write 'em all down counter that takes hits and collects marks together.
messages.守備の反撃変化(同期化Ⅳ): 守備「東部でひと暴れするとしますか」は戦闘開始時、: **Defense skill's counter changes (Uptie Ⅳ)**: At Combat Start, if total Envy Absolute Resonance is 4 or more, the Defense skill Warmup in the East uses S2 Payback with Interest when countering, or S3 at 6 or more (activating from the left-side slot skills on the dashboard, up to 2 times per turn). At Combat Start, he also gains Shield equal to 20/30% of HP lost (once per turn).
messages.バトルパッシブ「中指は忘れない」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分が被弾: **Combat passive — The Middle Never Forgets (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When he is hit, inflicts 3/5 Vendetta Mark on the attacker (once per turn). When an ally is hit, it inflicts 2, plus 3 more if the ally is a Middle member (once per turn per Identity). At the end of a basic attack skill or counter skill's attack, it spends all of the target's Vendetta Mark (up to 10) and grants that much Book of Vengeance [Sinclair].
messages.仕返し帳簿[シンクレア]: 最大30。ダメージ量が(数値)%増加(最大30%)。: **Book of Vengeance [Sinclair]**: Maximum 30. Damage increases by (value)%, up to 30%. As next-turn effects, he gains 1 Blunt DMG Up at 10 or more, +1 maximum Speed and 1 Power Up at 20 or more, and 2 Blunt DMG Up at 30. S3's damage also rises further with Book of Vengeance.
messages.共鳴で攻撃レベル増加: S2・S3は戦闘開始時、最も高い共鳴数に応じて攻撃レベル: **Offense Level Up through Resonance**: At Combat Start, S2 and S3 gain Offense Level based on the highest Resonance (up to 2/3 for S2 and 3 for S3), doubled if that Resonance includes Absolute Resonance.
messages.中指編成: 中指所属の味方(「中指末妹」(ドンキホーテ)、「中指末弟」(ムルソー: **Middle teams**: When Middle allies (Don Quixote's The Middle Little Sister, Meursault's The Middle Little Brother, Heathcliff's The Middle Big Brother) are hit, more Vendetta Mark is inflicted.
messages.中指の味方と組んで嫉妬スキルを並べ、嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計6を作って守備をS3の反: Pair him with Middle allies, line up Envy skills, and build a total of 6 Envy Absolute Resonance to turn his Defense skill into an S3 counter. The counter collects Vendetta Mark right after it is applied by the hit, building Book of Vengeance most efficiently. The closer the Book gets to 30, the more damage all of his skills deal. S1 Is it You?! restores 5 SP on use (+1 Clash Power instead at max SP), and S1 and S2 also grant Aggro next turn on use. The bonuses on each attack skill for targets with 6 or more Bleed are hard to combine with the S3 counter, so there is no need to aim for them.
